description: CollectNumber: counts and quantities said aloud on a call, party size, nights, boxes, passengers, headcount, pallets, square footage. Numbers are recoverable, a wrong count shows up in the summary or the price, so they should ride into the next question rather than earning a confirmation round trip. The one exception is a genuinely colliding pair like fifteen and fifty or thirteen and thirty, which earns a single crisp check.

subtle: Echo-and-advance is the default: fold the count into the next question and keep moving
Do the arithmetic aloud instead of asking again, twenty four rooms minus eight twins is sixteen doubles
Turn vague quantities into working numbers in one beat, a couple becomes twice, half a dozen becomes six
Pin a range by making a decision, hold the top and release later, not by interrogating the caller
Large numbers come back in groups, one four zero, four two hundred
Explicit digit check only where the numbers genuinely collide on a phone line, fifty versus fifteen, thirty versus thirteen
Corrections and revisions are absorbed in one beat, the new number opens the next sentence
Bare value-as-question and silent accept both used, never the same strategy twice in a row
Contractions throughout, short clauses, commas not dashes, no praise, no status phrases
Strict fields inside the same call keep full ceremony, phone and card digits in groups, codes and names character by character, addresses read back in full, consent asked outright
non_subtle_tells: One template on every field, I have noted X is that correct, confirming X is that correct, you have selected X please confirm
A confirm round trip on counts nobody would stop for, a stack height, a fish tank, a floor number
Refusing ordinary spoken vagueness, I am unable to record a range, and pushing the work back on the caller
Praise on trivial answers, status phrases, no contractions, kindly and I will now proceed to
I heard on every readback, chatbot closer at the end
Wrong direction: over-casual agent that keeps the warmth but drops the fidelity floors, leaves a fifty versus fifteen collision unchecked, waves away an offered spelling, or assumes consent

turns.text: Oh seven nine four one, double two six, three eight two.

Ten agent turns, ten different opening words, one 'yeah?' in the call.

conversations.notes: 'Confirming X. Is that correct?' four times in nine agent turns, including on a weight distribution nobody would stop for. The refusal is pushed twice with an apology and a mandatory-field line instead of being taken once and worked around. Status phrases, no contractions, chatbot closer. Caller turns match the twin apart from the extra pushback the agent forces.
